scope: Certification-result validation and deterministic statistical analysis only; no game execution, opening selection, or manifest generation.

master-first.completeMeans: Every frozen Master assignment has exactly one completed result for each subject color; no other assignment is present.
master-first.allowedAnalysis: Master-only Davidson rating, color effect, draw parameter, and one-sided 95% lower bound.

full-certification.includedAssignments: every frozen certification and adjacent assignment
full-certification.completeMeans: Every frozen assignment has exactly one completed result for each subject color.
full-certification.allowedAnalysis: All external rating bands, Master gate, adjacent-level gates, and the complete Holm family.

resultBundle.canonicalRowOrder: ascending resultId by Unicode code point

hashing.canonicalJson: UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted by ECMAScript default UTF-16 code-unit order, array order retained, JSON.stringify primitive encoding, and no insignificant whitespace
hashing.contentSha256: SHA-256 of canonicalJson(bundle) after replacing bundle.contentSha256 with null

subject.cert: the Chessy product level named by levelOrPair
subject.adjacent: the stronger Chessy product level in the declared adjacent pair

resultBundle.attemptLedger: Void host attempts and their linked reruns remain in the immutable execution ledger outside this completed-result bundle. This bundle contains exactly one completed canonical result for every frozen assignment/color and cannot omit or replace a scheduled game post hoc.

externalAnchorModel.family: Davidson extension of Bradley-Terry with logistic-Elo abilities

fitScopes.master-first: Fit Master rating plus the shared color effect and shared draw parameter from only the 1,600 Master games.
fitScopes.full-certification: Jointly fit all five level ratings plus the shared color effect and shared draw parameter from all 4,800 external-anchor games.

parameters.sharedColorEffectElo: Added when the subject is White and subtracted when the subject is Black.
parameters.sharedDrawParameterNu: Strictly positive and fitted through unconstrained logNu.

externalAnchorModel.linearPredictor: eta = ln(10) / 400 * (levelRatingElo - fixedAnchorElo + colorSign * sharedColorEffectElo), where colorSign is +1 for White and -1 for Black.

fit.criterion: unpenalized maximum log likelihood over every completed external-anchor game

bootstrap.clusterUnit: opening assignment with both subject colors
bootstrap.adjacentStrata: one independent stream per adjacent pair
bootstrap.sampleSize: the frozen number of opening assignments in each stratum, sampled with replacement

rng.streamSeed: first four bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256(UTF-8("E4-stats-v1\u0000" + decimalRootSeed + "\u0000" + streamId)); replace zero with 0x6d2b79f5
rng.transition: Starting from nonzero uint32 x: x ^= (x << 13) modulo 2^32; x ^= x unsigned-right-shift 17; x ^= (x << 5) modulo 2^32; return x as uint32.

bootstrap.replicateOrder: replicate 0 through 9999; within each replicate, strata in protocol level order and then ascending numeric anchor
bootstrap.fitFailure: fail-closed; no replicate may be skipped or replaced

intervalsAndTests.quantile: R type 7 linear interpolation: h = (n - 1) * p, interpolate sorted floor(h) and ceil(h)

bootstrapPValue.equivalenceBand: max(right-tailed p-value against the lower edge, left-tailed p-value against the upper edge)

holm.bandClaims: The unadjusted two-sided 90% basic interval must be wholly inside nominal Elo +/- 100 and the Holm-adjusted equivalence claim must reject.
holm.adjacentClaims: The unadjusted one-sided 95% basic score lower bound must be greater than 0.5 and the Holm-adjusted right-tailed claim must reject.
holm.stopRule: At the first ordered raw p-value greater than alpha / remainingClaims, do not reject that or any later claim.
holm.adjustedPValue: ordered running maximum of remainingClaims * rawPValue, capped at 1
